# Muhammad Hamza — Software Engineer & AI Developer

> **Canonical Identity**: Muhammad Hamza (born in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan) — Software Engineer, AI Developer, and product builder. Not to be confused with other individuals sharing this common name.

**Primary URL**: https://hamzax.me

**Location**: Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan

---

## Who is Muhammad Hamza?

Muhammad Hamza is a Software Engineer and AI Developer based in Peshawar, Pakistan. He is best known as the **Main Developer of Quizior** (https://quizior.live), an AI-powered exam and quiz evaluation platform. He is also the **Co-Founder of Solvia Codes** and **Co-Lead of Nexior**.

He studied at **City University of Science and Information Technology (CUSIT), Peshawar**.

---

## Core Expertise & Skills

- **Backend**: Python, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs
- **Frontend**: React, Vite, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript
- **AI/ML**: Google Gemini API, Groq API, OpenAI API, PyTorch, LangChain, Multi-Agent Systems
- **Testing & QA**: PyTest, JUnit, Katalon, BrowserStack, Selenium
- **Web Scraping & Automation**: Selenium, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy
- **Databases**: MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL
- **Mobile**: Android App Development (Java/Kotlin)
- **DevOps**: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker (basic)
- **Cloud**: Vercel, Render, GitHub Pages

## Major Projects

### Quizior (Main Developer)
- **URL**: https://quizior.live
- **Description**: AI-powered exam and quiz evaluation platform with real-time invigilation, AI-based subjective grading using Gemini and Groq APIs, multi-tenant architecture, and advanced anti-cheating measures.
- **Tech Stack**: PHP, MySQL, Python, Google Gemini API, Groq API, Perplexity API

### AI UI/UX Feedback System
- **Description**: Advanced multi-agent design auditor powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash. Features 6 specialized AI agents analyzing UI/UX, design aesthetics, copywriting, and conversion optimization.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Flask, MySQL, Multi-Agent AI

### QuizAura – AI-Powered Quiz System
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/muhammad-hamzadev/Ai_Based_Quiz_App
- **Description**: Comprehensive multi-tenant AI-assisted secure quiz platform with real-time invigilation and AI-based subjective grading.

### Terminal Chatbot
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/muhammad-hamzadev/terminal_chatbot
- **Description**: Command-line AI chatbot using Google Gemini 1.5 Flash with conversation logging and support for multiple AI providers (Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok).

### Attendance System
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/muhammad-hamzadev/Attendane_system_app
- **Description**: Desktop attendance management app built with Python/Tkinter.
